{{Quote|Your server will be here in a few moments.|Chadra-Fan hostess to Kosh Teradoc|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
This '''individual ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] who served as a hostess at a [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />  

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> she welcomed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] and four of his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to the club. She escorted them to the table where [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, was waiting. After they were seated, she informed them that their server would attend to them shortly before departing.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
